def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # find multicolor 3-tall block (columns of distinct colors, height>=2)
    block=None
    for j in range(w):
        col=[grid[i][j] for i in range(h)]
        nz=[v for v in col if v]
        if len(nz)>=2 and len(set(nz))>=2:
            # contiguous block of nonzero
            idx=[i for i,v in enumerate(col) if v]
            if idx==list(range(idx[0],idx[-1]+1)) and all(col[i]!=0 for i in range(idx[0],idx[-1]+1)):
                block=(idx[0],idx[-1],j,col[idx[0]:idx[-1]+1]); break
    bi0,bi1,bj,cols=block
    # reference shape: a single-color object that is not the block; take largest nonblock colored object
    # find all single-color connected-ish shapes by color
    colors={}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=grid[i][j]
            if v and not (bi0<=i<=bi1 and j==bj):
                colors.setdefault(v,[]).append((i,j))
    # ref cells: pick the color with most cells
    ref_color=max(colors,key=lambda c:len(colors[c]))
    cells=colors[ref_color]
    ri0=min(i for i,j in cells); ri1=max(i for i,j in cells)
    cj0=min(j for i,j in cells); cj1=max(j for i,j in cells)
    H=ri1-ri0+1
    pat=[[(1 if (i,j) in set(cells) else 0) for j in range(cj0,cj1+1)] for i in range(ri0,ri1+1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # erase block
    for i in range(bi0,bi1+1): out[i][bj]=0
    # place each color: slot index relative to ref color's slot
    # slots contiguous; ref occupies rows ri0..ri1. Slot k top row = ri0 + k*H
    # block column order defines order; index of ref color in block
    order=cols
    ridx=order.index(ref_color)
    present=set(order)
    for c in order:
        if c==ref_color: continue
        k=order.index(c)-ridx
        top=ri0+k*H
        for a,row in enumerate(pat):
            for b,v in enumerate(row):
                ii,jj=top+a,cj0+b
                if v and 0<=ii<h and 0<=jj<w:
                    out[ii][jj]=c
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    tg=tuple(map(tuple,grid))
    objs=objects(tg,univalued=True,diagonal=False,without_bg=True)
    mono=[o for o in objs if len(palette(o))==1]
    # bars: width-1, height>=2 solid vertical strips
    bars=[o for o in mono if width(o)==1 and height(o)>=2]
    bar_cells=set().union(*[set(toindices(o)) for o in bars]) if bars else set()
    cols={}
    for o in bars:
        j0=min(j for i,j in toindices(o)); cols[j0]=color(o)
    order=[cols[j] for j in sorted(cols)]
    # ref color: color with most non-bar cells
    counts={}
    for o in mono:
        c=color(o)
        if o in bars: continue
        counts[c]=counts.get(c,0)+len(o)
    # merge by color using ofcolor to be safe
    refc=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    cells={(i,j) for i,j in ofcolor(tg,refc) if (i,j) not in bar_cells}
    ri0=min(i for i,j in cells); ri1=max(i for i,j in cells)
    cj0=min(j for i,j in cells); cj1=max(j for i,j in cells)
    H=ri1-ri0+1
    pat=[[(1 if (i,j) in cells else 0) for j in range(cj0,cj1+1)] for i in range(ri0,ri1+1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i,j in bar_cells: out[i][j]=0
    rpos=order.index(refc)
    for c in order:
        if c==refc: continue
        k=order.index(c)-rpos
        top=ri0+k*H
        for a,row in enumerate(pat):
            for b,v in enumerate(row):
                if v:
                    ii,jj=top+a,cj0+b
                    if 0<=ii<h and 0<=jj<w: out[ii][jj]=c
    return out
